## 🛠️ Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] **Layout Style:** Enforce Auto Layout on all parent rows, columns, and grids.
- [ ] **Responsiveness:** Specify container rules (e.g., "Fill container" horizontally, "Hug contents" vertically).
- [ ] **Spacing & Radius:** Bind all gaps, padding, and corner radiuses to active layout tokens (e.g., `spacing/md`).
- [ ] **Color Tokens:** No raw HEX values; map background, text, and border elements strictly to semantic tokens.

## 💻 Tech Stack Context (For GitHub Copilot)
- **Framework:** Angular 21 (Standalone Components, Signals API)
- **UI Library:** Angular Material (Use native Material components where applicable)
- **Styling Utility:** Tailwind CSS (Combined with Material theme variables)
- **Architecture:** Strict separation of template/logic; leverage signal-based reactive inputs and state.
